expertise in research integration is essential, but often overlooked, for tackling complex societal and environment problems, and it is needed in two main areas: developing more comprehensive understandnings of complex problems, and supporting implementation of those understanding into government policy, communtiy practice, business and innovation, or other intiatives.
expertise in research integration, and implementation is essential to addressing complex societal and environment problems.
